LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 14.3.1 SENTENCES: SUBJECT- VERB AGREEMENT

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 14
Topic 14.3: Grammar in Use 14.3.1 Sentences: Subject- Verb Agreement
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 14.3.1 Sentences: Subject- Verb Agreement, part of Strand 14 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why should we follow rules when constructing a sentence?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify the subject and the verb in sentences,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Grammar in Use 14.3.1 Sentences: Subject- Verb Agreement in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. construct sentences ensuring subject-verb agreement,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Grammar in Use 14.3.1 Sentences: Subject- Verb Agreement in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. affirm the importance of subject-verb agreement in sentences. ● In groups, learners are guided to watch a demonstration, or signed video clips of verbs and practise signing them. ● In pairs, learners are guided to sign read texts on varied topics such as outdoor games and identify the subject and verbs in the sentences. ● In groups, learners are guided to brainstorm and make short notes on the relationship between a subject and a verb in a sentence in terms of number and person. ● In pairs, learners are guided to sign read sentences and label subject-verb agreement in them. ● In groups, learners are guided to make signed sentences based on outdoor sports in which the rule of subject-verb agreement has been applied. ● In pairs,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in Use 14.3.1 Sentences: Subject- Verb Agreement together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Self-efficacy: Learner independently constructs the correct sentences which have subject-verb agreement .

● Communication and Collaboration: Learner actively engages in collaborative experiences, both within pairs and small groups, to

brainstorm and make short notes on the relationship between a subject and a verb in a sentence in terms of number and person

Values:
● Integrity: is enhanced as learners openly share ideas of agreement.

Link to other Subjects

The learner relates the skill of constructing sentences to their learning in Kiswahili and Kenya Sign Language.
